trigger: Writing copy for food, beverage, coffee, restaurant, or retail lifestyle brands
symptom: User flagged that copy sounds 'robotic' or 'computer-like' (e.g. using 'SPECIMEN', 'MANIFEST', 'PROTOCOL', 'INDEX', 'DEPLOYMENT')
root_cause: Defaulting to high-tech, cyberpunk, or developer-native jargon instead of domain-authentic, warm, sensory culinary language
fix_applied: Replaced sci-fi nomenclature with authentic cafe words: 'Single-Origin Roasts', 'Harvest Batch', 'Tasting Notes', 'Shopping Bag', 'Order Online'
permanent_rule: When writing or designing for hospitality, food & beverage, or culinary retail, strictly forbid terminal/sci-fi terms (SPECIMEN, MANIFEST, INVENTORY HASH, PROTOCOL). Use grounded, tactile, sensory words (Fresh Roast, Curated, Warm, Batch, Bag, Table, Handcrafted).

trigger: Styling inline navigation links, badges, or pill buttons with bracketed accents
symptom: Trailing closing bracket ']' wrapped onto a separate line underneath the link label on wide screens
root_cause: Raw text format '[ ITEM ]' contains whitespace before the bracket; browser text wrapping engine treats space before ']' as a legal wrap opportunity
fix_applied: Removed loose spaces before brackets or replaced raw text with CSS pseudo-elements; enforced 'white-space: nowrap;' on all nav anchor items
permanent_rule: Never insert spaced bracket text '[ LABEL ]' in navigation or inline-flex elements. If bracket styling is desired, use CSS ::before and ::after pseudo-elements, or guarantee no whitespace before the bracket and enforce 'white-space: nowrap;' on the parent element.

trigger: Configuring Netlify static deployment with multi-page subdirectories or standalone sub-apps
symptom: Visiting subdirectory route like /aura-store loads 404 error page instead of index.html
root_cause: Catch-all 404 rewrite rule '/* /404.html 404' was placed before subdirectory rules or subdirectory lacked explicit index rewrites in _redirects and netlify.toml
fix_applied: Defined explicit subdirectory rewrites ('/aura-store/* /aura-store/:splat 200' and '/aura-store /aura-store/index.html 200') ABOVE the global catch-all rule
permanent_rule: In Netlify static sites with nested sub-projects, explicit subfolder rewrite rules MUST precede any global catch-all rule ('/* /404.html 404'). Also duplicate redirect configuration in both '_redirects' and 'netlify.toml' for guaranteed edge resolution across deploy contexts.

trigger: Building checkout flows, payment selectors, or order forms for Philippine (PHP / ₱) e-commerce
symptom: US/Western-centric payment options (Stripe Card only, Apple Pay) fail to meet local conversion expectations
root_cause: The predominant payment rail in the Philippines is digital mobile wallets (GCash, Maya, GrabPay) and Cash on Delivery (COD) / QR Ph
fix_applied: Implemented tabbed payment selector with GCash, Maya, Card, and Cash on Delivery, with phone input placeholder (+63 9XX XXX XXXX)
permanent_rule: When developing e-commerce checkout for the Philippines market, always include GCash, Maya, QR Ph, and Cash on Delivery (COD) as primary options alongside cards, and pre-fill phone number fields with Philippines format (+63 / 09XX).

trigger: Executing command line scripts or process wrappers on Windows PowerShell
symptom: PowerShell command fails with 'TerminatorExpectedAtEndOfString' or parser quotation syntax error
root_cause: Passing nested double quotes inside 'powershell -Command "..."' triggers premature string termination in Windows PowerShell parser
fix_applied: Avoid nested double quotes: pass Python scripts directly via file paths with clean args, use single quotes inside PowerShell commands, or use script files
permanent_rule: On Windows PowerShell environments, never nest double-quotes inside double-quoted command strings. Always pass arguments directly to Python executables, invoke dedicated script files, or escape with backticks (`") if inline string evaluation is unavoidable.

trigger: Printing Unicode or emoji characters to stdout on Windows terminals
symptom: UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode character: character maps to <undefined>
root_cause: Default Windows console stdout uses legacy code page (cp1252) which lacks glyphs for modern Unicode and emoji characters
fix_applied: Added sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8') in main() and replaced raw emojis with [OK], [NEW], [UPDATE] ASCII prefixes.
permanent_rule: In Python CLI scripts on Windows, always wrap stdout with sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8') or use ASCII status badges to prevent cp1252 charmap encoding crashes.

trigger: Deploying or updating site changes to Netlify
symptom: Deploying directly to Netlify causes repository drift and disconnects automated continuous deployment pipelines
root_cause: Netlify is connected to GitHub via continuous deployment (CI/CD); deploying via drag-and-drop bypasses git version control
permanent_rule: Always deploy and update portfolio and web projects by committing/pushing to GitHub rather than uploading directly to Netlify. Netlify automatically listens to the GitHub repository and deploys the latest commit.

symptom: Cover letter body text rendered blank because contact parser aborted prematurely
root_cause: Regex aborted on contact lines containing keyword portfolio
permanent_rule: Never terminate cover letter parsing on contact lines containing portfolio; only terminate on major section headers

symptom: HTTP 429 Rate Limit caused squad mission to abort with error.md
root_cause: Lack of exponential backoff retry and single-model dependency on Groq/Gemini
permanent_rule: Always implement exponential backoff retry (sleep 2-4s) and multi-model rotation pool on both Groq and Gemini
Always include quantifiable percentage or metric
